Welcome To Our Stop

Item Description:
Color: Gray
Size :Full(137*15*25CM)
Fill Material : Sponge

Package Include:
1*Bed Gap Pillow

About The Item:
BED WEDGE GAP FILLER: Pillow, remote or phone falling between your mattress and headboard? Not anymore! Sleep sound and peacefully, with the headboard pillow. Available in the following sizes, bed gap filler king, bed gap filler queen, bed gap filler full . The perfect pillow wedge for headboard gap.
WEDGE PILLOW DESIGN MATTRESS GAP FILLER: The unique design fills the headboard gap preventing items from falling, and also provides support for your head and neck ensuring a comfortable sleep.
CONVENIENT SIDE POCKETS: 2 side pockets designed to store your devices, remote glasses and more. Pockets have access hole to thread your charging wire to your device while in the pocket.
PREMIUM HIGH DENSITY FOAM: The Wedge Pillow for Headboards is crafted using premium high density foam for years of comfort and support. The foam blocks items from falling behind your mattress. No more searching for your belongings in the morning.
